result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in New York County. It also resolves the original conflict between §§28.1 and 28.2 while preserving the existing jurisdictional waivers and injunctive-relief exception. However, the conflict-of-laws and CISG exclusions were not necessary to satisfy the playbook and make the revision broader than needed.
